nodes.name: First electrodeposition of Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: The Ag NWs cloth is immersed in Co(NO3)2·6H2O solution, and the electro-deposition process is carried out for 500 s at -1.0 V with a saturated calomel electrode (SCE).
nodes.source_text: The Ag NWs cloth is immersed in Co(NO3)2·6H2O solution, and the electro-deposition process is carried out for 500 s at -1.0 V with a saturated calomel electrode (SCE).

nodes.name: Second electrodeposition of MoO3
nodes.procedure: And then, as-prepared Co(OH)2 is sequentially electrodeposited under a constant potential of -3.0 V for 500 s in (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O solution. Finally, the materials are washed with water and ethanol, and dried in air for subsequent measurements.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of MoO3-Co(OH)2@Ag NWs match crystalline MoO3 (JCPDS No. 37-0519), Ag (JCPDS No. 04-0783), and crystalline Co(OH)2 (JCPDS No. 02-0925) with strong Ag signal from nanowires.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD patterns of MoO3 - Co(OH)2@AgNWs , Co(OH)2@AgNWs , MoO3@AgNWs , and AgNWs materials (Fig. 3a) matched with crystalline MoO3 (JCPDS No. 37-0519), Ag (JCPDS No. 04-0783), and crystalline Co(OH)2 (JCPDS No. 02-0925).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images show MoO3-Co(OH)2@Ag NWs with flower-like shell and rachis-shaped core similar to peach twig morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The obtained MoO3 - Co(OH)2@Ag NWs consist of a flower-like shell and a rachis-shaped core, which is similar to a peach twig as shown in the inset of Fig. 2a.

properties.description: Composite image with SEM micrograph and inset

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show Ag nanowires coated with Co(OH)2 nanosheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM images show that two Ag nanowires are side by side and coated with a layer of Co(OH)2 nanosheets in Fig. 2c.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows MoO3 particles with lattice fringes of 0.21 nm (302) and 0.24 nm (40-1); Co(OH)2 with 0.23 nm (102) and 0.26 nm (110); heterostructure confirmed in MoO3-Co(OH)2@Ag NWs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM images of MoO3 particles exhibits the lattice fringes with the spacings of 0.21 and 0.24 nm (Fig. S4d), which corresponds to the (302) and (40-1) crystal planes of MoO3 , respectively...

properties.description: High-resolution TEM image with lattice fringes

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM confirms peach-twig structure with Ag on nanowires and Mo, Co, O distributed in flower-like shell.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The elemental distribution and morphological structure for a single MoO3 - Co(OH)2@AgNWs are confirmed by HAADF-STEM.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EDS elemental mapping confirms composition of ultrafine MoO3 particles and Co(OH)2 substrates in heterostructures.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The elemental mapping results (Fig. 2e-i), it can be concluded that the synthesized heterostructures were composed of ultrafine MoO3 particles and Co(OH)2 substrates.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS analysis shows atomic percentages of Co 23.1 at.%, Mo 0.8 at.%, O 22.1 at.% in MoO3-CO(OH)2 hybrid.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Moreover, the atomic percentages of Co, Mo and O are characterized to be 23.1, 0.8 and 22.1 at.% in MoO3 - CO(OH)2 hybrid by energy dispersive spectra (EDS) analysis (Fig.S6...

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS shows Mo6+ peaks at 232.5 and 235.7 eV, Mo5+ at 230.5 and 234.2 eV with negative shifts in heterostructure; Co2+ at 781.1 and 797.0 eV; O1s peaks at 532.8 eV (phys-chemisorbed water), 531.0 eV (M-O), 530.4 eV (oxygen vacancy) with negative shifts indicating strong electronic interaction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 3b suggests the formation of Mo6+ in MoO3 (peaks at 232.5 and 235.7 eV).[40] Meanwhile, there are the other two peaks at 230.5 and 234.2 eV, corresponding to the Mo5+ state... As for XPS spectrum Co 2p in Fig. 3c, it should be pointed out that Co 2p displays two main peaks located at 781.1 and 797.0 eV... As shown in Fig. 3d for O1s spectra of as-prepared MoO3 - Co(OH)2@Ag NWs, the peaks located at 532.8 eV , which can be physical-chemisorbed water at the material surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: LSV shows MoO3-Co(OH)2@Ag NWs overpotential of 220 mV at -100 mA cm^-2 vs 290 mV for Co(OH)2@Ag NWs and 412 mV for MoO3@Ag NWs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the required overpotentials for MoO3@Ag NWs, Co(OH)2@Ag NWs, and MoO3 - Co(OH)2@Ag NWs at 100 mA cm^-2 are 412, 290, and 220 mV , respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Tafel slope of MoO3-Co(OH)2@Ag NWs is 60.9 mV dec^-1 vs 82.5 mV dec^-1 for Co(OH)2@Ag NWs and 115.9 mV dec^-1 for MoO3@Ag NWs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: MoO3 - Co(OH)2@Ag nanowires hybrid exhibits a much smaller Tafel slope ( 60.9 mV dec^-1 ) than that of MoO3@Ag NWs ( 115.9 mV dec^-1 ) and Co(OH)2@Ag NWs ( 82.5 mV dec^-1 )

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows charge transfer resistance Rct of 0.91 Ω for MoO3-Co(OH)2@Ag NWs vs 1.65 Ω for Co(OH)2@Ag NWs, 10.15 Ω for MoO3@Ag NWs, 19.33 Ω for Ag NWs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the charge transfer resistance (Rct) value (0.91Ω) of MoO3 - Co(OH)2@Ag NWs is smaller than that of Ag NWs (19.33 Ω ), MoO3@Ag NWs (10.15 Ω ) and Co(OH)2@Ag NWs (1.65 Ω ).
